masteryZone.q: What is the primary target of intensive subsistence farming?
masteryZone.sol: Intensive subsistence focuses on feeding the local farm family.

masteryZone.q: Nomadic herding is a type of which agricultural system?
masteryZone.sol: Nomadic herding is a primitive subsistence activity.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Shifting cultivation is settled farming.
masteryZone.sol: False. Shifting cultivation involves moving fields every few years.

masteryZone.q: What is the seasonal migration of herders between mountain pastures and valleys called?
Which crop is most commonly grown in plantation agriculture?
masteryZone.sol: Tea, coffee, and rubber are typical plantation crops.
Mixed farming combines crop cultivation with animal husbandry on the same farm.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Extensive commercial grain farming has high yield per hectare.
masteryZone.sol: False. Extensive farming has low yield per hectare but high yield per worker.

masteryZone.q: Large coffee estates in Brazil are known as:
masteryZone.sol: Large Brazilian coffee estates are called Fazendas.

masteryZone.q: What is shifting cultivation called in Mexico?
masteryZone.sol: It is called Milpa in Mexico and Central America.

masteryZone.q: Shifting cultivation is known as 'Ray' in which country?
masteryZone.sol: It is called Ray in Vietnam.

masteryZone.q: True or False: In Western Ghats of India, shifting cultivation is called Kumari.
masteryZone.sol: True. In Kerala and Western Ghats it is called Kumari.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Shifting cultivation is called Podu in Jharkhand.
masteryZone.sol: False. It is called Kuruwa in Jharkhand. It is called Podu in Andhra Pradesh/Odisha.

masteryZone.q: Which state of India is fully certified organic?
masteryZone.sol: Sikkim is the first fully organic state of India.

masteryZone.q: Growing crops in stacked layers indoors is known as:
masteryZone.sol: This vertical arrangement is called Vertical Farming.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Hydroponics requires rich organic soil.
masteryZone.sol: False. Hydroponics is soil-less cultivation in water solution.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Precision farming aims to optimize resource use using modern sensors/GPS.
masteryZone.sol: True. Precision agriculture uses technology to deliver exact inputs to crops.
